title: 白骨の書架と終焉の特急
author: 黒羽 レイ

en.title: The Bone Bookshelf and the Apocalypse Express
en.premise: In a city where people sell slices of their memories to survive, a man known as the "Bookshelf Keeper" collects forbidden memories. One day he sets out to find a ticket for the "Final Train" that will take him to the edge of the world, in order to save the soul of his dying sister. He confronts the cruel truth that lies in the abyss of the underground library, and the desperate price demanded in return. A man who has abandoned light—will the last thing he grasps be salvation or eternal solitude?

zh.title: 骨书架与终末特急
zh.premise: 在一座人们通过出售记忆碎片来维持生存的城市里，一名被称为“书库守”的男子收集禁忌记忆。某天，他开始寻找通往世界尽头的“终极列车”车票，以拯救垂死妹妹的灵魂。他将面对隐藏在地下图书馆深渊中的残酷真相，以及所需支付的绝望代价。放弃光明的男子，最终握住的究竟是救赎还是永恒孤独？
